trust_and_semantics.retirement: Compact expiry/capacity evicts and moves explicit monotonically increasing retired floor. Admission checks floor before and AFTER any pressure-driven compaction; old unseen IDs cannot resurrect on mid-push capacity eviction
trust_and_semantics.error_boundary: Invalid raw FEC schema/epoch/ID does not allocate or advance floor; profile conflicts and contradictory authenticated metadata tombstone the block, never undo already given original
